title: DLMF 1.1 Special Notation: (For other notation see Notation for the Special Functions .)
summary: DLMF 1.1 Special Notation: (For other notation see Notation for the Special Functions .)
body: NIST DLMF section 1.1 (Special Notation) says: "(For other notation see Notation for the Special Functions .) In the physics, applied maths, and engineering literature a common alternative to \overline{a} is a^{*} , a being a complex number or a matrix; the Hermitian conjugate of \mathbf{A} is usually being denoted \mathbf{A}^{{\dagger}} ." This card records that section's wording and equation alt text. It does not retypeset a formula the alt text did not carry.
